rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Rent Coordination (Ordinance 2026-99)
rules.requirement: Owners of buildings with six or more dwelling units in Cambridge may not use an algorithmic rent coordination service to set rents or occupancy levels. Violations carry a fine of $300 per unit per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services for 6+ unit buildings
rules.quoted_span: No owner of a residential building containing six or more dwelling units in the City of Cambridge shall use an algorithmic rent coordination service to set rents or occupancy levels for any dwelling unit in such building
rules.effective_date_note: Section 8.80.040 states the ordinance takes effect March 1, 2027 (adopted September 14, 2026); future effective date relative to the query date.
rules.interaction: New local ordinance; does not amend or replace any existing Cambridge rule. MA S.2983/H.5222 are pending and not law, so no state rule is affected.
rules.review_note: Source document is labeled a test fixture / fictional; treat with caution.

parsed.notes: Only the newly added document N001 (Cambridge Ordinance 2026-99, ch. 8.80) was processed. Existing Cambridge rules in context were not repeated. The document is labeled a fictional test fixture.
